text:
#!name=百度网盘
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0061 / 百度网盘 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0340 / 百度网盘去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/rest\/\d\.\d\/pcs\/adx/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/rest\/2\.0\/pcs\/ad/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/act\/v\d\/(bchannel|welfare)\/list/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/act\/api\/activityentry/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/pmall\/order\/privilege\/info/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/rest\/.+\/pcs\/adx/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/api\/useractivity\/activity/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/act\/.+\/bchannel\/list/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/api\/certuser\/get/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/component\/view\/(1510|1130)\?vip/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ndstatic\.cdn\.bcebos\.com\/activity\/welfare\/js\/.+\.js/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ndstatic\.cdn\.bcebos\.com\/activity\/welfare\/index\.html/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/staticsns\.cdn\.bcebos\.com\/amis\/.+\/banner.png/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/issuecdn\.baidupcs\.com\/issue\/netdisk\/guanggao/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/update\.pan\.baidu\.com\/statistics/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/fc-video\.cdn\.bcebos\.com/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/rp\.hpplay\.cn\/logouts/i then reject(404)

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/api\/getconfig\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/api\/getsyscfg\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/api\/taskscore\/tasklist\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/act\/api\/activityentry\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/rest\/\d\.\d\/pcs\/adv\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/api\/plugin\/get\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/recommend\/query\/list\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[Body Rewrite]
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/pan\.baidu\.com\/feed\/kingkongdistrict\? '.data.data |= map(select(.type != "novel" and .type != "shortplay" and .type != "print" and .type != "job_hunt"))'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% pan.baidu.com, ndstatic.cdn.bcebos.com, staticsns.cdn.bcebos.com, issuecdn.baidupcs.com, update.pan.baidu.com, fc-video.cdn.bcebos.com, rp.hpplay.cn
